$comment: Shared behavioural contract for the map, directions, and institutional-publicity destination category (#3184). server/src/utils/researchHomeWebsiteUrl.ts and client/src/utils/researchDetailSources.ts carry independent copies of the same rule, because the server refuses the destination as a stored websiteUrl while the client refuses it as the detail page's headline action. Both suites read this table, so a divergence fails on both sides rather than waiting for someone to notice; the press-and-news pair next door drifted by six entries inside the pull request that introduced it. Every path leaf below is synthetic.

refused.name: a school's own news article page
a news article page under a department subpath
a media player page under a department subpath
a maps destination query with no directions mode
a directions link on any other host

kept.name: a lab site on its own domain
a newsroom index that is not an article page
a lab page whose leaf merely contains the word media
a search page that names a map
a host whose registrable domain merely ends in a map host
